purpose: Measure FERMAT rollout runtime, GPU memory, horizon completion, and diabetes token hit rate before selecting the main Task 30 run size.
cohort_rule: Exact validated diabetes Cox modelable test cohort identified only by person_id membership in cox_test_predictions.parquet.

runtime_basis.source: stopped Task 30 diabetes rollout Pod run

benchmark_rationale.patients: Four outcome-blind patients provide repeated timing across different prefix lengths while keeping the benchmark short.
benchmark_rationale.rollouts: Sixteen futures are exactly divisible by both batch sizes and give four batch-4 calls versus two batch-8 calls per patient.
benchmark_rationale.claim_boundary: Technical benchmark only. Do not report its hit rate as a calibrated risk estimate or compare it with observed or Cox curves.
